title: blandina biflora
intro: Blandina biflora, commonly known as Butterfly Pea, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. The health benefits of Blandina biflora include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various purposes. The bioactive constituents of Blandina biflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to contribute to its medicinal properties.
